mapper.select: SELECT id, bgmbmc, bgjglx, sb_djid, zhid, ksdm, sfbz, bz, bgmbnr, srrq FROM bgxt_bgmb ORDER BY id
SELECT id, bgmbmc, bgjglx, sb_djid, zhid, ksdm, sfbz, bz, bgmbnr, srrq FROM bgxt_bgmb WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, bgmbmc, bgjglx, sb_djid, zhid, ksdm, sfbz, bz, bgmbnr, srrq FROM bgxt_bgmb WHERE sb_djid = #{sbDjid} AND zhid IS NULL AND ksdm IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, bgmbmc, bgjglx, sb_djid, zhid, ksdm, sfbz, bz, bgmbnr, srrq FROM bgxt_bgmb WHERE ksdm = #{ksdm} AND sb_djid IS NULL AND zhid IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, bgmbmc, bgjglx, sb_djid, zhid, ksdm, sfbz, bz, bgmbnr, srrq FROM bgxt_bgmb WHERE sb_djid IS NULL AND zhid IS NULL AND ksdm IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bgxt_bgmb (bgmbmc, bgjglx, sb_djid, zhid, ksdm, bz, bgmbnr, srrq) VALUES (#{bgmbmc}, #{bgjglx}, #{sbDjid}, #{zhid}, #{ksdm}, #{bz}, #{bgmbnr}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE bgxt_bgmb SET bgmbmc=#{bgmbmc}, bgjglx=#{bgjglx}, sb_djid=#{sbDjid}, zhid=#{zhid}, ksdm=#{ksdm}, bz=#{bz}, bgmbnr=#{bgmbnr} WHERE id=#{id}
